findings.description: ADR-012 states that every authentication failure returns a bounded 401 'with no body'; live requests return 401 with the ASP.NET Core [ApiController] framework application/problem+json body (type/title/status/traceId). Independently reproduced again in this audit. No secret, header, candidate, or configuration detail is reflected, and the divergence is accurately documented in docs/limitations.md D1.
evidence: live (this audit): wrong secret -> same 401 shape; grep for the candidate value in all 5 response bodies -> (none)
findings.recommended_action: Track for a future ADR-012 clarification or suppress the framework body. Non-blocking; no leakage.

findings.description: ArtworkSubjectGate.Gates is a process-local static ConcurrentDictionary<string, SemaphoreSlim> keyed by item id + image surface with no idle eviction or LRU bound. Growth is bounded in practice by the distinct Jellyfin library items the host itself holds, is not attacker-controllable, and is not a log/state path. Recorded as docs/limitations.md D2 (task 7.4 finding 7.4-R1).
findings.recommended_action: Optional post-V1 idle eviction/LRU bound. Accepted for V1.

findings.description: No provider inventory/catalogue cache: every reconciliation work item re-reads the whole provider library and the per-record file resource, so the 'avoid unnecessary API requests' goal is only partially met for provider fetches. Render and publication are correctly fingerprint-gated. Recorded as docs/limitations.md F1 and is the reason criterion 6 is partial.
evidence: attempt-1 live: unchanged re-run -> image tags and served bytes identical, but 5 new mock requests
findings.recommended_action: Deferred to Post-V1 (bounded short-TTL inventory cache and/or revision-token skip). Accepted for V1.

findings.description: ConfigurationSnapshotService.TryReplace is implemented and validated but is not wired to Jellyfin's configuration-save path, so a saved webhook secret, provider enable/disable, badge/selector change, or limit change is not observed until process restart. Recorded as docs/limitations.md F2. All per-operation limit resolutions already read the current snapshot.
evidence: src/ArrTags/Configuration/ConfigurationSnapshotService.cs (TryReplace not called by a config-save subscriber)
this audit: configuration was applied by restart, the documented supported mechanism
findings.recommended_action: Tracked for Post-V1. Accepted for V1.

findings.description: No bounded, secret-free user-facing or diagnostic metrics/status surface exists, although the internal counters do. Documented as a recommendation, not a hard V1 gate (docs/limitations.md F3, architecture section 12).

Scheduled/post-scan/manual reconciliation enumerates from the start of a deterministic order, so a scope larger than QueueCapacity (default 512) covers only a bounded prefix and successive runs overlap rather than advancing. Recorded as docs/limitations.md F4. Event/webhook/per-item triggers are unaffected.
findings.recommended_action: Tracked for Post-V1. Accepted for V1.

findings.description: The tolerant ADR-010 non-canonical cross-runtime comparison requires a second explicitly selected non-canonical Linux runtime and its golden set; none is selected, so the comparison is skipped. Same-runtime golden and byte-determinism coverage passes. Recorded as docs/limitations.md V2.
evidence: this audit: RendererCrossRuntimeTests/NonCanonicalRuntimeFactAttribute skip in all three runs (default, host-guarded, forced-native)
findings.recommended_action: Select and record a second runtime in a future milestone, or keep as an explicit environment limitation. Accepted for V1.

security_checked: Secrets never leak: this audit observed 0 occurrences of the configured Sonarr/Radarr API keys or webhook secret in the host console log and the mock request log; attempt-1 additionally found 0 in plugin persisted state and webhook HTTP responses. The values appear only in Jellyfin's PluginConfiguration file (ADR-005 design) and in docs as documented mock fixture values (RR-15).

Secret boundary: IPluginSecretResolver/SecretLease expose typed, version-matched leases; SecretLease.ToString excludes the value; API keys are applied only as X-Api-Key headers (never URL/query); webhook authentication uses CryptographicOperations.FixedTimeEquals with a 1024-char bounded candidate (re-read ArrTagsWebhookController.cs this audit).
Authoritative state is never evicted as cache; invalid authoritative state is quarantined (attempt-1 live-reproduced) and invalid cache state is discarded.
Atomic writes: AtomicFileWriter uses a flushed temp file + File.Move(overwrite:true); StateEnvelopeCodec carries a schema version and SHA-256 payload integrity.

Lifecycle fence + write-ahead ordering: ArtworkPublisher re-reads the durable fence before writing Prepared, immediately before the image mutation, and before the final state commit; a complete operation is persisted before any Jellyfin image mutation.

limitations_accepted: F1 / RR-7 - No provider inventory/catalogue cache; provider metadata is fetched per work item. Consequence: a large library performs one provider-library read per work item, so GOALS criterion 6 is only partially met for provider fetches. Evidence: docs/limitations.md F1; attempt-1 observed 5 provider reads on an unchanged re-run that performed no render/publication.

F2 / RR-8 - Runtime configuration replacement is not wired to Jellyfin's save path. Consequence: secret/provider/badge/limit changes require a process restart. Evidence: docs/limitations.md F2; src/ArrTags/Configuration/ConfigurationSnapshotService.cs.
F3 / RR-9 - No bounded metrics/diagnostic-status surface. Consequence: no supported in-product view of queue depth/provider health. Evidence: docs/limitations.md F3; architecture section 12.

F4 / RR-10 - Reconciliation coverage is bounded by QueueCapacity. Consequence: a scope larger than 512 covers only a bounded prefix per run; event/webhook/per-item triggers unaffected. Evidence: docs/limitations.md F4; architecture lines 472-478.

F5 - Renderer depends on a host-supplied SkiaSharp with no bundled fallback. Consequence: a host without a compatible SkiaSharp fails closed (preserve current artwork); validated only on the pinned linux-musl-x64 Jellyfin 12.0.0 host; the plugin makes no RID-specific claim. Evidence: docs/limitations.md F5; ADR-015; attempt-1 live publication.

V1 - No live Sonarr/Radarr instance. Consequence: provider payload-shape variance beyond the committed fixtures is untested; contract-covered per ADR-013. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V1; mock fixture live run.

V2 / RR-11 - ADR-010 non-canonical cross-runtime comparison unselected/unrun. Consequence: the tolerant half of the ADR-010 strategy is an environment limitation; same-runtime golden/byte-determinism passes. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V2.
V3 / RR-12 - Jellyfin Enhanced coexistence is contract-level only. Consequence: live overlap/placement with Enhanced is unverified. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V3.

V4 / RR-13 - Automated live SaveImage read-back absent. Consequence: the live round trip is manual; the shipped artifact was live-verified by attempt-1. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V4; attempt-1 live served-vs-persisted identity match.

V5 / RR-14 - Live uninstall drain: the release audit exercised it successfully (204, install+state removed, artwork restored) and V5 was refreshed; the automated coverage remains the in-process tests. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V5 (refreshed).

V6 - Host-guarded facts are skipped without the pinned host. Consequence: the default ./build.sh test does not exercise the real host discovery/route/native-render paths; the host-guarded and forced-native runs do. Evidence: docs/limitations.md V6; this audit's three-suite matrix.

P1 / RR-4 - Byte-reproducibility depends on the pinned toolchain and has no automated byte-identity guard. Consequence: a different SDK could change bytes; a packer/build-property regression would not fail the suite. Evidence: docs/limitations.md P1; this audit's independent reproduction.
P2 / RR-16 - Reduced debug metadata for reproducibility. Consequence: harder source-level debugging of the released assembly; no runtime impact. Evidence: docs/limitations.md P2.

P3 - PackagePlugin=true stages but does not write the archive; ./build.sh package is the entry point. Consequence: direct MSBuild invocation must be followed by the packer. Evidence: docs/limitations.md P3.
P4 / RR-17 - SkiaSharp license notices ship although SkiaSharp is not redistributed. Consequence: extra attribution files only. Evidence: docs/limitations.md P4; ADR-015.

P5 / RR-18 - Pre-release orphaned state/uninstall-drain retention. Consequence: an unreleased developer install must delete PluginsPath/ArrTags once; an incomplete drain retains the relocated state root by design. Evidence: docs/limitations.md P5; ADR-014.

D1 / RR-5 - Webhook 401 body differs from ADR-012's 'no body' text (ProblemDetails type/title/status/traceId). Consequence: cosmetic wording gap; no sensitive detail reflected. Evidence: docs/limitations.md D1; this audit's live 401 responses.

D2 / RR-6 - ArtworkSubjectGate has no idle eviction. Consequence: one semaphore retained per distinct (item, surface) for process lifetime; bounded in practice and not attacker-controllable. Evidence: docs/limitations.md D2.

RR-1 - Phases 1-3 lack independent phase-review records. Consequence: their gate claims rest on changelog/PLANS evidence rather than a contemporaneous independent review; the integrated behaviour is covered by later phases, the full suite, and this audit. Evidence: docs/limitations.md:334-352 (recorded); absence of docs/implementation/phase-1..3 review files.

RR-15 - Documented mock fixture API keys in tracked docs. Consequence: none; test-only values, never production credentials. Evidence: docs/limitations.md:354-365 (recorded); docs/testing/jellyfin-12-musl-test-host.md:173-174.

summary: ArrTags 0.1.0 is ready to ship with accepted, recorded limitations. The release candidate is frozen at HEAD 6926a9a0475209890c162c4a90e6f873dab26240 (clean tree, main +15, phase tags v0.1.0-phase1..7, no v0.1.0 tag). The release-0.1.0 corrective commit 6926a9a is documentation-only (PLANS.md, docs/implementation-readiness.md, docs/limitations.md, and the final-review records; git diff 040ea0d..6926a9a shows no src/tests/scripts/build/artifact change), and it closes the attempt-1 condition-5 gap: RR-1 and RR-15 are recorded in docs/limitations.md with evidence and consequence, V5 is refreshed (RR-14), RR-3 is fixed (readiness RID label linux-musl-x64), and RR-2 is fixed (criterion-6 wording qualified). I independently reproduced the release artifact from a clean git-archive export: it is byte-identical to the recorded identity (567,856 bytes, SHA-256 bd10b9b6bf5d31049082d27625b18ba127eb6e2860a454fe2d3c35ccebaaee51, 7 entries, every per-entry hash matched, manifest version 0.1.0.0 / targetAbi 12.0.0.0 / framework net10.0, no duplicate SkiaSharp/HarfBuzz runtime) and cmp-equal to the frozen artifacts/ArrTags_0.1.0.0.zip. The clean build reported 0 warnings / 0 errors; the default suite was 1218 passed / 60 skipped / 1278 total, the host-guarded suite 1234 / 44 / 1278, and the forced-native suite 1291 / 17 / 1308 with 0 failed - all equal to the recorded baselines. Because the artifact and code are unchanged, I reused attempt-1's full live publication pipeline evidence (real SaveImage publication, served-vs-persisted identity, source byte-unchanged, changed/unchanged metadata, provider outage, restart, authenticated uninstall, corrupt-state quarantine) and independently re-verified on the pinned Jellyfin 12.0.0 musl host that the reproduced artifact installs and loads with exactly one 'Loaded plugin: ArrTags 0.1.0.0' and 0 [FTL]/[ERR], and that the webhook boundary returns 401/401/202/400/413 with no secret reflected and 0 Arr calls. Both historical release blockers (7.2-F1 install-layout collision, 7.3-F1 duplicate-SkiaSharp fatal conflict) are independently confirmed fixed; no BLOCKER or HIGH finding remains open; all prior task/phase findings are resolved, accepted, or tracked. The only material residual is the partial GOALS criterion 6 (no provider catalogue cache, F1) plus the accepted verification/packaging limitations, all recorded in docs/limitations.md. One MEDIUM process gap (phases 1-3 lack independent phase-review records) is accepted and now recorded; the former LOW documentation-precision nits (RR-2, RR-3) are resolved. Decision: SHIP_WITH_ACCEPTED_LIMITATIONS.
